category: # Free Humanoid Platform — Leg v0.1 reference BOM (single leg)
# REFERENCE BOM — NOT VALIDATED BY PHYSICAL BUILD. All prices ~2026 retail USD at unit-quantity-1 academic pricing. Confirm vendor part numbers and prices before purchase.
# Architectural commitment: §9 #1 — hybrid actuator distribution. Hip + Knee = cycloidal reducer (corpus sumitomo-cyclo). Ankle = QDD (corpus mini-cheetah / cassie-osu).
# Quantities are PER LEG. Double for the bipedal pair.

description: Onvio S-series style cycloidal reducer (alternate: commodity Chinese cycloidal RV-30E), ratio 30:1, output rated 100 N·m continuous / 200 N·m peak, hip-yaw flange
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Hip yaw peak ~80 N·m design target sits comfortably below the 200 N·m peak rating with 2.5x margin. Sumitomo CYCLO 6000 is the price-premium alternative at ~$900.

description: Maxon EC-i 50 brushless DC, 200 W, 48 V flat-rotor; nom. torque 0.42 N·m, peak 1.5 N·m, no-load 6500 rpm
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Catalog ID approximate; verify exact 48V variant before order. Pair with 30:1 cycloidal yields ~12.6 N·m continuous / ~45 N·m peak motor-torque-limited; cycloidal preload sets practical ceiling.

description: mjbots Moteus n1 brushless servo controller, CAN-FD, 6S–14S, 100A peak, integrated MCU and FOC firmware
notes: price confirmed from public mjbots listing as of 2026-Q1; verify before purchase.

description: AMS AS5048A 14-bit magnetic rotary encoder, SPI, with diametric N35H magnet, mounted on cycloidal output flange
notes: price approximately confirmed. Output-shaft absolute encoder (post-reduction).

description: 4-element foil strain-gauge bridge + carrier ring for cycloidal output torque sensing, 350 Ω, 24-bit ADC (HX711-class)
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Optional but recommended; pairs with sensing-proprioceptive-actuator chain.

description: Aluminum 7075 milled hip-yaw housing, ~180 g part, hosts cycloidal flange + motor mount face (Xometry quote)
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. CNC 2-op aluminum, 1 hr at $90/hr + material.

description: Deep-groove ball bearing, 35 mm ID x 55 mm OD x 10 mm, sealed, NTN/SKF
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. One pair preloaded against cycloidal output flange.

description: Cycloidal reducer ratio 50:1, output rated 150 N·m continuous / 300 N·m peak, hip-abduction flange
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Hip abduction peak ~120 N·m sits below 300 N·m peak rating with 2.5x margin.

description: Maxon EC-i 50 brushless DC, 200 W, 48 V flat-rotor (same SKU as hip-yaw motor)
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. With 50:1 yields ~21 N·m cont / ~75 N·m peak — cycloidal-preload-limited to ~150 N·m intermittent.

description: mjbots Moteus n1 (per joint)
AMS AS5048A 14-bit magnetic rotary encoder + magnet on hip-abd output
Output-shaft strain-gauge bridge for hip-abd (optional v0.1)
Aluminum 7075 milled hip-abd housing, ~200 g part
Deep-groove ball bearing, 35 mm ID x 55 mm OD x 10 mm, sealed
Cycloidal reducer ratio 50:1, high-torque variant, output rated 200 N·m continuous / 400 N·m peak, hip-flexion flange
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Hip flexion peak ~150 N·m design target — single-leg-stance gravitational moment dominates. 400 N·m peak rating gives 2.6x safety margin.

description: Maxon EC-i 52 brushless DC, 320 W, 48 V flat-rotor; nom. 0.65 N·m, peak 2.5 N·m
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Larger motor (320 W vs 200 W) for hip flexion — single highest-torque joint in the leg. T-Motor U10II at $450 is a hobbyist alternative with similar mech specs.

description: mjbots Moteus n1 (per joint)
AMS AS5048A 14-bit magnetic rotary encoder + magnet on hip-flex output
Output-shaft strain-gauge bridge for hip-flex (recommended; high-load joint)
Aluminum 7075 milled hip-flex housing, ~240 g part
Deep-groove ball bearing, 40 mm ID x 62 mm OD x 12 mm, sealed (larger for flex)
Cycloidal reducer ratio 30:1, high-torque variant, output rated 150 N·m continuous / 300 N·m peak, knee flange
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Knee peak ~150 N·m for stair-climb / squat-recovery; 300 N·m peak rating gives 2x margin. 30:1 ratio chosen lower than hip-flex 50:1 for knee velocity headroom.

description: Maxon EC-i 50 brushless DC, 200 W, 48 V (same SKU as hip-yaw/abd)
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. With 30:1 yields ~12.6 N·m cont / ~45 N·m peak motor-torque-limited; cycloidal-preload sets practical ceiling.

description: mjbots Moteus n1 (per joint)
AMS AS5048A + magnet on knee output flange
Output-shaft strain-gauge bridge for knee (recommended)
Aluminum 7075 milled knee housing, ~210 g part
Deep-groove ball bearing, 35 mm ID x 55 mm OD x 10 mm, sealed
T-Motor U8 Lite KV150 outrunner BLDC, 240 g, peak ~6 N·m at 40 A; QDD-class flat-rotor (Mini Cheetah lineage)
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Mini-Cheetah-class QDD: low-ratio planetary + BLDC. Substitute Maxon EC-i 40 + GP 32 for higher-precision academic build.

description: Maxon GP 32 HP planetary head, ratio 6.6:1, single-stage, 4.5 N·m continuous / 6.25 N·m intermittent
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Single-stage planetary (low backlash, higher backdrivability than cycloidal). Combined with U8 motor: ~40 N·m peak at output, ~12 N·m continuous.

description: mjbots Moteus c1 brushless servo controller, CAN-FD, smaller form factor than n1, 30A peak (sufficient for ankle QDD)
notes: price confirmed approximately. c1 vs n1 saves cost and mass for the lower-torque ankle joints.

description: AMS AS5048A + magnet on ankle-pitch output
Aluminum 6061 milled ankle-pitch housing, ~140 g part (lighter than hip housings — 6061 acceptable for ankle)
Deep-groove ball bearing, 25 mm ID x 42 mm OD x 9 mm, sealed
T-Motor U8 Lite KV150 outrunner BLDC (same SKU as ankle-pitch QDD)
Maxon GP 32 HP planetary head, 6.6:1 (same SKU as ankle-pitch)
mjbots Moteus c1 (same SKU as ankle-pitch)
AMS AS5048A + magnet on ankle-roll output
Aluminum 6061 milled ankle-roll yoke, ~120 g part
Deep-groove ball bearing, 25 mm ID x 42 mm OD x 9 mm, sealed
ATI Mini40 6-DOF force-torque sensor, SI-40-2 calibration, 40 N axial / 2 N·m torque range, ethernet/CAN DAQ
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. THIS IS THE DOMINANT SINGLE LINE COST. Lower-cost alternative: Robotous RFT40-SA01 at ~$2200, or in-house strain-gauge-bridge foot at ~$200 (lower accuracy). Optional for v0.1 walking — defer to v0.2 if budget-constrained.

description: 6061-T6 aluminum tube, 38 mm OD x 3.2 mm wall (~6 in approx), 450 mm length, anodized clear
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Femur structural tube; 380 mm working length per descriptor + 70 mm end-cap allowance. Note: corrected to a realistic OD (38 mm) for a 50 kg humanoid; 6-inch OD is overkill.

description: 6061-T6 aluminum tube, 32 mm OD x 3.0 mm wall, 420 mm length, anodized clear
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Tibia structural tube; 380 mm working length per descriptor.

description: Aluminum 6061 femur end-caps (2x), milled to mate cycloidal output flange (hip-flex side) and knee-cycloidal input flange (knee side); ~80 g each
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. 2 caps machined as a pair.

description: Aluminum 6061 tibia end-caps (2x), milled to mate knee output (top) and ankle-pitch input (bottom); ~70 g each
Foot plate, aluminum 6061 milled, 150 x 100 x 8 mm, ~320 g, with FT-sensor mount + silicone-pad bond pattern
Smooth-On Dragon Skin 50 platinum-cure silicone, 50A durometer, trial pint kit (~0.5 lb sample) for foot pad casting
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. 50A is firmer than the 30A used on the hand; foot pad needs higher durometer for ground contact.

description: Smooth-On Sil-Poxy silicone-to-aluminum adhesive, 1 oz tube
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Bonds silicone foot pad to aluminum foot plate.

description: Aluminum 6061 hip-yaw-to-pelvis interface plate, ~180 g, 4x M8 through-holes on 80 mm PCD
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Bolts to pelvis flange in torso.

description: M8 x 30 mm socket-head cap-screws, A2 stainless, 4-pack
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Hip-to-torso primary bolts.

description: M8 nylon-insert flange lock-nuts, A2 stainless, 4-pack
McMaster M3 / M4 / M5 socket-head cap-screw assortment kit, A2 stainless, 8-30 mm lengths
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Joint housing fasteners + mounts.

description: CAN-FD daisy-chain harness, 6-drop with Molex PicoClasp 4-pin termini, ~2 m total length, 120 Ω termination at far end
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Connects 4 Moteus n1 + 2 Moteus c1 to upstream torso bus.

description: 12 AWG silicone-jacket high-flex stranded wire, 2-conductor (red+black), 4 m for 48 V power bus from torso BMS to leg distribution
XT60 power-distribution PCB with 6 outputs (4x for n1, 2x for c1), 30A continuous each, with bulk capacitor
LEMO 2B series 10-pin push-pull connector, plug, solder cup; carries 48 V power + CAN-FD + spares from torso to leg
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Pelvis-side bulkhead. Molex Mini-Fit Sr 10-circuit at ~$15 is the hobbyist alternative.

description: LEMO 2B series 10-pin push-pull connector, receptacle, panel-mount, solder cup
Silicone-jacket 26 AWG stranded wire, 6-color assortment, 10 m total for encoder + sensor harnessing within leg
3M FP-301 heat-shrink assortment, 2:1, 3–13 mm
Loctite 243 medium-strength threadlocker, 10 mL bottle (blue) — for cycloidal output flange bolts
Krytox GPL 226 PFPE grease, 8 oz tube — for cycloidal-reducer cavity packing + bearing relubrication
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Cycloidals ship pre-greased; this is service replenishment + ankle planetary repacking.

description: McMaster oil-impregnated SAE 841 bronze flanged sleeve bushing assortment (5 mm / 8 mm / 12 mm ID), 12 pcs
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Spares for joint-axle rebuilds during bring-up.
